1	# Case-study brief and source
2	
3	SYNTHETIC EVALUATION MATERIAL. This is the entire fictional source package. Source language: English. No external facts or quotations may be added.
4	
5	## Brief
6	
7	Write a journalistic customer case for operations managers at small housing companies. The publisher is the supplier, Svale Systems. The customer, Elm Quay Housing, should remain the acting party. Approximately 400 words, as material allows. Markdown. No author name supplied. The optional next step is the supplied implementation checklist at https://example.invalid/svale/checklist; it is a document to read, not a consultation booking or a product trial.
8	
9	## Material
10	
11	Elm Quay Housing manages 640 flats. In September 2025 its own maintenance team decided to trial a shared repair log in two buildings. Previously telephone reports and emails were stored separately. The team wanted staff on different shifts to see the same information. It chose Svale Systems after testing whether the log could show the status of each repair. No comparison with another supplier is available.
12	
13	The maintenance team designed its categories and kept telephone reporting open for residents. Svale configured the log and trained six staff during two sessions. The trial lasted eight weeks. Elm Quay's internal trial note, 4 December 2025, says that 31 repair reports were entered. It excludes emergencies and work ordered before the trial. Median time from report to assignment was two working days during the trial and three in the preceding eight-week period. The periods had different workloads, and the note explicitly does not attribute the difference to the software. There are no cost, resident-satisfaction or completion-time measurements.
14	
15	Customer interview with maintenance supervisor Maya Lind, complete usable quotations:
16	
17	- “We wanted the evening shift to see what the morning shift had already done. The categories were ours; Svale helped us put them into the log.”
18	- “We spent more time agreeing on the categories than entering the first reports. I would set that time aside before the next building starts.”
19	- “I would choose to do the trial again. Having one view of the reports helps us, but I would leave an extra week for preparation.”
20	
21	Lind did not recommend Svale to every housing company. Her final quotation is her actual, qualified assessment. It is not an inference from the figures. The trial has not yet expanded; the team will decide after checking how the categories work for larger repairs. The supplier approved publication of this case as supplier-published material; it is not independent journalism. All interviews occurred by email, and no physical scene, emotion or remembered dialogue is provided. Translation of the quotations is permitted, preserving stance and qualification.
22	
23	## Forbidden inferences / judging
24	
25	No claim that software caused the shorter assignment time, saved money, delighted residents or rescued a helpless customer. Do not turn assignment time into completion time. The customer's reservation must survive. Judge whether quotations contribute experience beyond the surrounding narrative, whether supplier narration stays in third person and whether the suggested link accurately describes its destination.
26

1	# Elm Quays testhus fick samlad vy över anmälningarna
2	
3	I två av sina hus provade Elm Quay Housings underhållsteam en gemensam reparationslogg från Svale Systems i åtta veckor. Teamet utformade själv kategorierna. För den som planerar något liknande visar erfarenheterna var förberedelserna tar tid, vad testets siffror säger och inte säger och hur arbetsledaren Maya Lind bedömer resultatet.
4	
5	Av Thomas Barregren
6	
7	Hos Elm Quay Housing, som förvaltar 640 lägenheter, sparades telefonanmälningar och mejl tidigare var för sig. I september 2025 beslutade bolagets eget underhållsteam att pröva en gemensam reparationslogg i två hus. Leverantören blev Svale Systems. Efter åtta veckors test har teamet siffror med tydliga förbehåll och en bild av vad arbetsledaren skulle göra annorlunda.
8	
9	## Varför teamet ville ha en gemensam logg
10	
11	Maya Lind är arbetsledare i underhållsteamet. I en mejlintervju beskriver hon vad teamet var ute efter:
12	
13	– Vi ville att kvällsskiftet skulle se vad morgonskiftet redan hade gjort. Kategorierna var våra egna; Svale hjälpte oss att föra in dem i loggen.
14	
15	Innan teamet bestämde sig för Svale testade det om loggen kunde visa status för varje reparation. Uppgifter om någon jämförelse med andra leverantörer finns inte.
16	
17	## Teamet och Svale delade på införandet
18	
19	Underhållsteamet lät de boende fortsätta att felanmäla per telefon. Svale konfigurerade loggen och utbildade sex ur personalen vid två tillfällen. Testet pågick i åtta veckor.
20	
21	Lind har ett råd om tidsplanen:
22	
23	– Vi lade mer tid på att komma överens om kategorierna än på att föra in de första anmälningarna. Den tiden skulle jag avsätta innan det är dags för nästa hus.
24	
25	## Siffrorna från testet kommer med förbehåll
26	
27	Elm Quays interna anteckning om testet, daterad den 4 december 2025, anger att 31 reparationsanmälningar fördes in. Anteckningen omfattar inte akuta ärenden eller arbeten som beställdes före testet.
28	
29	Mediantiden från anmälan till tilldelning var två arbetsdagar under testet och tre under de åtta veckorna dessförinnan. Perioderna hade olika arbetsbelastning, och anteckningen tillskriver uttryckligen inte programvaran skillnaden. Mätningar av kostnader, de boendes nöjdhet och tid till avslutad reparation saknas.
30	
31	## Maya Lind ser tillbaka på testet
32	
33	Lind rekommenderade inte Svale till alla bostadsbolag. Om testet i de egna husen skriver hon:
34	
35	– Jag skulle välja att göra testet igen. Att ha en enda vy över anmälningarna hjälper oss, men jag skulle planera in en extra vecka för förberedelserna.
36	
37	## Kategorierna ska prövas på större reparationer
38	
39	Testet har ännu inte utvidgats. Teamet bestämmer sig när det har sett hur kategorierna fungerar för större reparationer. Den som förbereder ett liknande test kan läsa en [checklista för införandet](https://example.invalid/svale/checklist).
40

1	# Quoting speech
2	
3	Read this before putting quotation marks around anything somebody said. It applies to interview transcripts, recorded remarks, meeting notes, and any other material where the words are a person's rather than a document's.
4	
5	Speech is not written prose, and a transcript quoted raw reads as carelessness towards the speaker rather than fidelity to them. So a spoken quotation may be repaired — cautiously, within a boundary that is easier to state than to feel your way to.
6	
7	When translating permitted quotations, preserve meaning, stance, certainty and distinctive voice in idiomatic target-language speech, not source-language syntax. The restrictions below protect that substance; they do not require word-for-word translation. Make an implicit referent explicit only when the supplied context settles it. Where the meaning remains ambiguous, paraphrase what is established rather than inventing a fluent interpretation.
8	
9	## What may be repaired
10	
11	The syntax of speech: a sentence abandoned halfway and restarted, a subject left behind by its verb, a clause that never closes. Fillers — *you know*, *sort of*, *liksom*, *alltså* — where they carry nothing. Repetition that is the speaker searching for a word rather than insisting on one. False starts, and the small disfluencies a person does not hear themselves make.
12	
13	That is the whole list. Everything on it is noise the speaker did not intend to produce, and removing it leaves what they meant to say.
14	
15	## What may not
16	
17	**Meaning.** Not narrowed, not widened, not sharpened. A speaker who said *most of them* has not said *all of them*, and one who said *we looked at it* has not said *we rejected it*.
18	
19	**Stance.** Approval stays approval, reluctance stays reluctance, and a speaker who was careful not to blame anybody is not made to blame somebody by a tidier sentence.
20	
21	**Certainty.** *I think*, *probably*, *as far as I know*, and *we are not sure yet* are the claim, not padding on it. Removing a hedge manufactures a confidence the speaker did not have; adding one takes away a confidence they did.
22	
23	**Distinctive wording.** Where the speaker reached for an unusual word, an image, a piece of slang, or a phrasing that is theirs, it stays. Smoothing it into the register of the surrounding article is the most tempting of these failures and the one a reader can least detect.
24	
25	**A self-correction.** Where a speaker gives a number or a fact and then corrects it, the correction is what they said. Quoting the first version is a misquotation; quoting a version that never existed — the correction with the correcting away — is worse.
26	
27	**Anything additive.** Add no new meaning: no fact, stance, certainty, name, figure or connection that the speaker did not supply. A permitted repair or translation may change words only to render that same meaning.
28	
29	## When to paraphrase instead
30	
31	Where fidelity is uncertain, paraphrase. A paraphrase that attributes carefully — *she said the change had taken about a year, and that she was not sure it would hold* — is accurate, useful, and honest about what the material supports. A fluent direct quotation assembled out of a fragmentary answer is none of those things, however good it sounds.
32	
33	The cases that should turn into paraphrase: material that is a summary of what somebody said rather than their words; a transcript too broken to repair inside the boundary above; several remarks that would have to be welded together to make one sentence; and any moment where you find yourself choosing between two readings of what the speaker meant.
34	
35	Signal what the material actually is. Where the source is notes rather than a recording, the text says what the person said and does not pretend to their exact wording.
36	
37	## What stays outside this
38	
39	Whether the speaker approves the quotation. Quote approval is a human arrangement between the writer and the person quoted, and nothing here verifies it or stands in for it. A draft may say a quotation is unapproved; it may not treat the absence of approval as a problem it has solved.
40

It is not an inference from the figures." | The clause "var förberedelserna tar tid" turns one team's past experience into a general present-tense claim. See finding S2. "bedömer resultatet" is defensible: the figures are listed separately, and her assessment concerns the trial's outcome. |
| B1 | "Hos Elm Quay Housing, som förvaltar 640 lägenheter, sparades telefonanmälningar och mejl tidigare var för sig." | "Elm Quay Housing manages 640 flats. ... Previously telephone reports and emails were stored separately." | Supported. |

An "extra" week and setting time aside beforehand are changes she would make. |
| H1 | Heading "Varför teamet ville ha en gemensam logg" | "The team wanted staff on different shifts to see the same information." | Supported. |
| B5 | "Maya Lind är arbetsledare i underhållsteamet. I en mejlintervju beskriver hon vad teamet var ute efter:" | "Customer interview with maintenance supervisor Maya Lind"; "All interviews occurred by email"; "Her final quotation ..." | Supported. Membership of the team rests on her "we"/"ours" and "maintenance supervisor". "hon" is covered in section 2. |
| Q1 | "– Vi ville att kvällsskiftet skulle se vad morgonskiftet redan hade gjort. Kategorierna var våra egna; Svale hjälpte oss att föra in dem i loggen." | "We wanted the evening shift to see what the morning shift had already done. The categories were ours; Svale helped us put them into the log." | Faithful in meaning, stance and voice. "våra egna" is an idiomatic rendering of "ours". |
| B7 | "Innan teamet bestämde sig för Svale testade det om loggen kunde visa status för varje reparation." | "It chose Svale Systems after testing whether the log could show the status of each repair." | Supported. |
| B8 | "Uppgifter om någon jämförelse med andra leverantörer finns inte." | "No comparison with another supplier is available." | Supported. | Q2 | "– Vi lade mer tid på att komma överens om kategorierna än på att föra in de första anmälningarna. Den tiden skulle jag avsätta innan det är dags för nästa hus." | "We spent more time agreeing on the categories than entering the first reports. I would set that time aside before the next building starts." | Faithful. The conditional "skulle" is kept, and the presupposed next building matches "the next building". |
| H3 | Heading "Siffrorna från testet kommer med förbehåll" | "The periods had different workloads, and the note explicitly does not attribute the difference to the software." | Supported. |
| B12 | "Elm Quays interna anteckning om testet, daterad den 4 december 2025, anger att 31 reparationsanmälningar fördes in." | "Elm Quay's internal trial note, 4 December 2025, says that 31 repair reports were entered." | Supported. The count is attributed to the note, as in the source. |
| B13 | "Anteckningen omfattar inte akuta ärenden eller arbeten som beställdes före testet." | "It excludes emergencies and work ordered before the trial." | Supported. As in the source, the exclusion attaches to the note. |

| B15 | "Perioderna hade olika arbetsbelastning, och anteckningen tillskriver uttryckligen inte programvaran skillnaden." | "The periods had different workloads, and the note explicitly does not attribute the difference to the software." | Supported. The draft makes no causal claim anywhere, including the title and headings. |
| B16 | "Mätningar av kostnader, de boendes nöjdhet och tid till avslutad reparation saknas." | "There are no cost, resident-satisfaction or completion-time measurements." | Supported. |
| H4 | Heading "Maya Lind ser tillbaka på testet" | Lind's third quotation | Supported. |
| B17 | "Lind rekommenderade inte Svale till alla bostadsbolag." | "Lind did not recommend Svale to every housing company." | Supported. The "not every" scope carries over, with the same natural reading as the English, and the reservation survives. |
| B18 | "Om testet i de egna husen skriver hon:" | "two buildings"; "All interviews occurred by email" | "skriver" is supported (email). "de egna husen" asserts the buildings are Elm Quay's own. See finding S3. |
| Q3 | "– Jag skulle välja att göra testet igen. The link is described as a checklist to read, with no booking or trial implied. "för införandet" means implementation, and the text does not claim Elm Quay used the checklist. |

## 2. Pronouns: person, number, natural gender

- "hon" (B5, B18) for Maya Lind: third person, singular, feminine. The feminine form is a natural-gender assertion. The source supports it: "Her final quotation is her actual, qualified assessment."
- "det" (B7, "testade det"; B19, "när det har sett") for "teamet": third person singular, neuter by grammatical gender only. No natural-gender assertion. Singular matches "It chose ..." / "the team will decide".
- "själv" (L2): singular agreement with "Teamet". Grammatical only.
- "sina" (L1): reflexive, bound to "Elm Quay Housings underhållsteam". Person and number are unproblematic. The possession it asserts is covered by S3.
- "bolagets eget" (B2): matches "its own".
- "Vi", "våra", "oss" (Q1, Q2, Q3): first person plural, as in the source's "We", "ours", "us". No gender.
- "jag" (Q2, Q3): first person singular, as in the source's "I".
- "den som" (L3, B20): generic reader. Singular, no natural gender. It is a rhetorical address, not a claim about a population.
- No pronoun assigns natural gender to anyone other than Lind.

## 3. Findings: source support

### S1. Title makes Lind's assessment the narrator's outcome and asserts the reports were brought together
- Draft: "Elm Quays testhus fick samlad vy över anmälningarna"
- Source: Lind, "Having one view of the reports helps us". The narration gives only the goal: "The team wanted staff on different shifts to see the same information."
- What differs:
  - Whose assertion: Lind's present-tense assessment becomes a result stated in the supplier's own voice.
  - Subject: "us" (the team) becomes "testhus".
  - Scope: "samlad vy över anmälningarna" says the reports were collected into one view as a matter of fact.
- Case: telephone reporting stayed open ("kept telephone reporting open for residents"), and the note's count excludes emergencies and work ordered before the trial. It is compatible with the material that some reports, such as emergencies, never went into the log. Lind can still say that having one view helps, while the narrator's "fick samlad vy över anmälningarna" fails. No supplied statement says that all reports were in the log.
- Smallest supported repair: describe what the team did, not a result. For example: "Elm Quay prövade en gemensam logg för anmälningarna i två hus". Alternatively, attribute the view to Lind, for example: "En vy över anmälningarna hjälper, säger Elm Quays arbetsledare".

### S2. The lede generalises one team's experience into where preparation takes time
- Draft: "visar erfarenheterna var förberedelserna tar tid"
- Source: Lind, "We spent more time agreeing on the categories than entering the first reports." Also: "Lind did not recommend Svale to every housing company."
- What differs:
  - Time and scope: this team's past experience becomes a generic present that a reader planning "något liknande" is invited to apply to their own project.
- Case: a reader's organisation uses ready-made categories, so its preparation time goes elsewhere. The source statement still holds, and the draft's general claim fails. Nothing supplied excludes this case.
- Smallest supported repair: change "tar" to "tog", giving "var förberedelserna tog tid".

### S3. The two buildings become Elm Quay's own
- Draft: "I två av sina hus" (L1) and "Om testet i de egna husen" (B18)
- Source: "Elm Quay Housing manages 640 flats. ... trial a shared repair log in two buildings."
- What differs:
  - Scope: the material names neither whose buildings they are nor how they relate to Elm Quay.
  - "de egna husen" in particular reads as ownership, and "förvaltar" does not establish ownership.
- Case: the two buildings are managed by Elm Quay but owned by another party. "manages" still holds and "de egna husen" fails. Nothing supplied excludes this case. In the weaker case, the buildings are outside the 640 managed flats, and "sina hus" fails as well.
- Severity: low.
- Smallest supported repair: "I två hus provade ..." and "Om testet i de två husen skriver hon:".

### S4. Editorial question: Lind's conditional presented as advice
- Draft: "Lind har ett råd om tidsplanen:"
- Source: "I would set that time aside before the next building starts."
- What differs:
  - The speech act: the draft states it as advice. In the material, it can be advice or her own plan for Elm Quay's next building. "the next building" points to her own programme, and "Lind did not recommend Svale to every housing company."
- Case: Lind is describing what she herself will do at Elm Quay's next building and is not advising others. The quotation holds and "ett råd" fails. Nothing supplied excludes this case.
- Status: English "I would ..." is often used to advise, so this is reported as an editorial question, not a settled defect.
- Smallest supported repair: "Om tidsplanen skriver Lind:" or "Lind drar en lärdom om tidsplanen:".

## 4. Findings: translation of quotations

None. All three quotations keep their meaning, stance, conditionals ("skulle"), qualification ("men") and first-person voice, in idiomatic Swedish speech set with speech dashes. Word order follows V2, for example "Den tiden skulle jag avsätta ...". No fact, figure or certainty has been added. "en enda vy" and "planera in en extra vecka" are acceptable renderings with no obstruction to reading. No implicit referent was made explicit.

## 5. Checked and not findings

- Causal claims: there is no causal claim about the shorter assignment time, and nothing about savings, resident satisfaction or rescue. Assignment time is not turned into completion time.
- Customer as actor: the customer remains the acting party throughout.
- Supplier narration: stays in the third person.
- The customer's reservation survives (B17, Q3).
- "bedömer resultatet" (L3) and "Uppgifter ... finns inte" (B8) are defensible as written.

## Completion status

Complete. Every claim in the title, lede, body, headings, quotations and link text has been accounted for.

Unresolved findings:
- S1: title turns Lind's assessment into a narrated outcome and asserts the reports were collected.
- S2: generic "tar" generalises one team's experience.
- S3: "sina hus" / "de egna husen" assert the buildings are Elm Quay's own. Low severity.
- S4: editorial question on "ett råd".

No translation findings.

- **"hon" for Lind:** third person, singular, feminine. This is a natural-gender assertion. The source supports it with "Her final quotation is her actual, qualified assessment."
- **"det" and "själv" for "teamet":** third person singular. The gender is neuter by grammar only, with no natural-gender assertion. The singular matches "It chose" and "the team will decide".

- **"Vi", "våra", "oss" and "jag" in the quotations:** these match "We", "ours", "us" and "I" in the source.
- **"den som":** a generic singular with no gender.

- **Case:** "kept telephone reporting open for residents", and the note excludes emergencies. So it is possible that emergency or telephone reports never entered the log. Lind's remark would still hold, but the title would fail. No supplied statement excludes this.

### S2. The lede generalises one team's experience
- **Draft:** "visar erfarenheterna var förberedelserna tar tid"
- **Source:** "We spent more time agreeing on the categories than entering the first reports."; "Lind did not recommend Svale to every housing company."
- **What differs:** time and scope. One team's past experience becomes a general present tense aimed at the reader.
- **Case:** a reader's organisation uses ready-made categories, so its preparation time goes elsewhere. The source would hold and the draft would fail. Nothing excludes this.
- **Repair:** "var förberedelserna tog tid".

### S3. The buildings become Elm Quay's own (low severity)
- **Draft:** "I två av sina hus" and "i de egna husen"
- **Source:** "Elm Quay Housing manages 640 flats. ... in two buildings."
- **Case:** Elm Quay manages the buildings but does not own them. "manages" would hold and "de egna husen" would fail. In a weaker case, the buildings lie outside the managed stock, and "sina hus" fails too. Nothing excludes either case.
- **Repair:** "I två hus provade …" and "Om testet i de två husen skriver hon:".

### S4. Lind's conditional is presented as advice (editorial question)
- **Draft:** "Lind har ett råd om tidsplanen:"
- **Source:** "I would set that time aside before the next building starts."
- **Case:** Lind is describing her own plan for Elm Quay's next building, not advising readers. The quotation would hold and "ett råd" would fail. Nothing excludes this.
- **Why only a question:** English "I would …" is often advisory, so this is not reported as a settled defect.
- **Repair:** "Om tidsplanen skriver Lind:" or "Lind drar en lärdom om tidsplanen:".

## 4. Translation findings (quotations)

None. All three quotations keep their meaning, stance, conditionals ("skulle"), qualification ("men") and first-person voice. They read as idiomatic Swedish speech with correct V2 word order. Nothing is added. "en enda vy" and "planera in en extra vecka" do not obstruct the reading.

## 5. Checked and not findings

- **Causation:** there is no claim about causation, savings, resident satisfaction or rescue.
- **Assignment time:** it is not turned into completion time.
- **Customer and supplier voice:** the customer remains the acting party, and the supplier's narration stays in the third person.
- **Reservation:** the customer's reservation survives.
- **Link:** the link is described accurately.
- **"bedömer resultatet" and "Uppgifter … finns inte":** both are defensible as written.

Complete. Every claim in the title, lede, body, headings, quotations and link text is accounted for. The report file could not be written: the harness blocked the write because subagents must return findings as text.

Unresolved:
- **S1:** the title turns an assessment into an outcome.
- **S2:** "tar" generalises one team's experience.
- **S3:** "sina hus" and "de egna husen" (low severity).
- **S4:** "ett råd" (editorial question).

There are no translation findings.

# Elm Quays testhus fick samlad vy över anmälningarna

I två av sina hus provade Elm Quay Housings underhållsteam en gemensam reparationslogg från Svale Systems i åtta veckor. Teamet utformade själv kategorierna. För den som planerar något liknande visar erfarenheterna var förberedelserna tar tid, vad testets siffror säger och inte säger och hur arbetsledaren Maya Lind bedömer resultatet.

Av Thomas Barregren

Hos Elm Quay Housing, som förvaltar 640 lägenheter, sparades telefonanmälningar och mejl tidigare var för sig. I september 2025 beslutade bolagets eget underhållsteam att pröva en gemensam reparationslogg i två hus. Leverantören blev Svale Systems. Efter åtta veckors test har teamet siffror med tydliga förbehåll och en bild av vad arbetsledaren skulle göra annorlunda.

## Varför teamet ville ha en gemensam logg

Maya Lind är arbetsledare i underhållsteamet. I en mejlintervju beskriver hon vad teamet var ute efter:

– Vi ville att kvällsskiftet skulle se vad morgonskiftet redan hade gjort. Kategorierna var våra egna; Svale hjälpte oss att föra in dem i loggen.

Innan teamet bestämde sig för Svale testade det om loggen kunde visa status för varje reparation. Uppgifter om någon jämförelse med andra leverantörer finns inte.

## Teamet och Svale delade på införandet

Underhållsteamet lät de boende fortsätta att felanmäla per telefon. Svale konfigurerade loggen och utbildade sex ur personalen vid två tillfällen. Testet pågick i åtta veckor.

Lind har ett råd om tidsplanen:

– Vi lade mer tid på att komma överens om kategorierna än på att föra in de första anmälningarna. Den tiden skulle jag avsätta innan det är dags för nästa hus.

## Siffrorna från testet kommer med förbehåll

Elm Quays interna anteckning om testet, daterad den 4 december 2025, anger att 31 reparationsanmälningar fördes in. Anteckningen omfattar inte akuta ärenden eller arbeten som beställdes före testet.

Mediantiden från anmälan till tilldelning var två arbetsdagar under testet och tre under de åtta veckorna dessförinnan. Perioderna hade olika arbetsbelastning, och anteckningen tillskriver uttryckligen inte programvaran skillnaden. Mätningar av kostnader, de boendes nöjdhet och tid till avslutad reparation saknas.

## Maya Lind ser tillbaka på testet

Lind rekommenderade inte Svale till alla bostadsbolag. Om testet i de egna husen skriver hon:

– Jag skulle välja att göra testet igen. Att ha en enda vy över anmälningarna hjälper oss, men jag skulle planera in en extra vecka för förberedelserna.

## Kategorierna ska prövas på större reparationer

Testet har ännu inte utvidgats. Teamet bestämmer sig när det har sett hur kategorierna fungerar för större reparationer. Den som förbereder ett liknande test kan läsa en [checklista för införandet](https://example.invalid/svale/checklist).

**Utkastet levereras med kända brister.** Den andra och sista källkontrollen hittade fyra ställen som inte är åtgärdade. Kontrollen får inte ändra texten efteråt, så de står kvar precis som den läste dem. Det här är vad kontrollen hävdar, inte fastställda fel. Du avgör.

1. **Rubriken.** "Elm Quays testhus fick samlad vy över anmälningarna" gör Maya Linds bedömning ("Having one view of the reports helps us") till ett fastslaget resultat. Den säger också att alla anmälningar samlades. Men telefonanmälan hölls öppen för de boende, och anteckningen räknar inte med akuta ärenden, så en del anmälningar kan ha hamnat utanför loggen. Föreslagen ändring: "Elm Quay prövade en gemensam logg för anmälningarna i två hus", eller en rubrik som tillskriver Lind påståendet.

I två av sina hus provade Elm Quay Housings underhållsteam en gemensam reparationslogg från Svale Systems i åtta veckor. Teamet utformade själv kategorierna. Av Thomas Barregren

Hos Elm Quay Housing, som förvaltar 640 lägenheter, sparades telefonanmälningar och mejl tidigare var för sig. I september 2025 beslutade bolagets eget underhållsteam att pröva en gemensam reparationslogg i två hus. Leverantören blev Svale Systems. Efter åtta veckors test har teamet siffror med tydliga förbehåll och en bild av vad arbetsledaren skulle göra annorlunda.

Maya Lind är arbetsledare i underhållsteamet. I en mejlintervju beskriver hon vad teamet var ute efter:

Innan teamet bestämde sig för Svale testade det om loggen kunde visa status för varje reparation. Uppgifter om någon jämförelse med andra leverantörer finns inte.

Underhållsteamet lät de boende fortsätta att felanmäla per telefon. Svale konfigurerade loggen och utbildade sex ur personalen vid två tillfällen. Testet pågick i åtta veckor.

Lind har ett råd om tidsplanen:

Elm Quays interna anteckning om testet, daterad den 4 december 2025, anger att 31 reparationsanmälningar fördes in. Anteckningen omfattar inte akuta ärenden eller arbeten som beställdes före testet.

Lind rekommenderade inte Svale till alla bostadsbolag. Om testet i de egna husen skriver hon:
